document: R06 proposed qualification budgets and workload recipes
status: proposed experiment targets; not measured, approved release limits or runtime enforcement

measurement_policy.reference_host: Proposed Apple Silicon Mac, 16 GiB RAM, local SSD, native app at 60 Hz; actual chip/OS/runtime/build/power/input-source required in each run. A different host is a separately labelled result.

editor_layout.font: Pin actual family, version and size in run manifest; do not compare wrap movement with a substituted font.

measurement_policy.method: Release candidate builds, 5 warm-up cycles, 30 measured opens/catch-ups, 1000 input/operation samples across at least 5 fresh sessions per workload. Nearest-rank quantiles; retain raw samples. Cold-start runs are separately labelled. Manual native input/service correctness runs are separate from timing loops.
measurement_policy.latency_definition: Input-to-presentation requires observable presentation/video or OS instrumentation; event-to-frame/transaction timing is a different labelled proxy. Local-durable latency ends at honest backend durability acknowledgement, not UI paint.
measurement_policy.memory_definition: Aggregate resident footprint of authority, app shell/renderers and helper processes; report idle, peak and post-close plateau separately. Baseline-subtracted retained growth also recorded.
measurement_policy.failure_policy: Any correctness violation blocks, regardless of performance percentiles. Run full operation correctness under budget pressure; refusal/backpressure must preserve work.

workloads.purpose: Immediate input and first two-view slice
Mixed editing, table, media and local durability
Scale exploration; target failure is reported, not silently declared unsupported

fixture_recipe.text: Paragraph i is the decimal i left-padded to 6 chars followed by ASCII x repeated to reach the declared length. Stable fixture IDs p-i; separate top-level text array order. Counts exclude table cells/task bodies.
fixture_recipe.tasks: Fixture IDs t-i, title Task i; each has one placement in note n1, one paragraph body Details i and independent properties; no task-parent relation.
fixture_recipe.tables: One header row plus rows-1 data rows, columns as declared; each cell text r{row}c{column}; header included in count.
fixture_recipe.history: Version i changes paragraph p-1 final character to digit i mod 10; semantic version identity remains distinct even if text repeats. Pin first and middle versions.
fixture_recipe.media: Use valid synthetic PNG and PDF fixtures with pinned byte SHA-256; alternate references. Initial render uses 1 MiB decoded image budget per image fixture and a 20-page synthetic PDF. Do not invent asset hashes or render arbitrary bytes as a valid PDF. Assets are generated/verified at harness preparation.
fixture_recipe.unicode_use: Separate fixture paragraphs exactly as strings above, with named grapheme boundaries recorded by the chosen Unicode segmentation version; include both bidi directions and select across boundaries.

input_limits_proposal.validation: All lengths measured before allocation where possible; aggregate and streaming budgets mandatory, including many individually small frames. Oversize commands refuse before admission and preserve input. Large valid content uses a separate bounded staged protocol, never arbitrary bypass. Exact limits are proposed R07 adversarial inputs, not final note-size promises.

lifetime_retry_proposals.retry_jitter: full jitter with injected deterministic RNG in simulation
lifetime_retry_proposals.rules: Deadlines are observations, never proof of nonexecution. Idle exit requires protected work; outbox resumes next start. No retry cap may silently discard pending content. Poll only while a capable process is running; provider-specific quota/backoff may override toward less traffic with explicit status. No offline-replica retirement timer selected.
